newsitem.title: USA: FTC raises concerns about Staples merger - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: FTC raises concerns about Staples merger - WSJ.

text.p: Serious antitrust concerns are being raised by the Federal Trade Commission about Staples Inc's proposed $3.3 billion acquisition of Office Depot Inc, The Wall Street Journal reported Friday.
The concerns could delay or force a change in the deal, the paper said.
The agency is trying to determine whether superstores lower prices in cities where they compete with other superstores, the story says.
An FTC spokesman declined to comment for The Journal's story.
A Staples official is quoted as saying the FTC told him to expect an answer on the merger by the end of January.
Staples maintains that the office-supply market is highly competitive and that a combined Staples-Office Depot would have only about five percent of the total market, the story says.
